20		reSlotProc  = regexp.MustCompile(`slot\s+(\d+)\s+is\s+processing`)
21		reSlotRel   = regexp.MustCompile(`slot\s+(\d+)\s+released`)
22		reModelLoad = regexp.MustCompile(`llm_load_tensors:\s+offloading\s+(\d+)\s+layers\s+to\s+GPU`)

26	// eventParser implements io.Writer. It buffers bytes, splits on newlines,
27	// writes each complete line to slog.Debug (preserving existing behaviour), and
28	// sends a structured ServerEvent to ch. Sends are non-blocking; if ch is full
29	// the event is dropped and Dropped is incremented.
30	type eventParser struct {
31		log     *slog.Logger
32		name    string
33		ch      chan<- ServerEvent
34		buf     bytes.Buffer
35		Dropped uint64
36	}

38	// NewEventParser returns an eventParser for the named backend.

43	func (p *eventParser) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
44		p.buf.Write(data)
45		for {
46			b := p.buf.Bytes()
47			idx := bytes.IndexByte(b, '\n')
48			if idx < 0 {
49				break
50			}
51			line := string(b[:idx])
52			p.buf.Next(idx + 1)
53			if len(line) == 0 {
54				continue
55			}
56			p.log.Debug(line, "backend", p.name)
57			ev := p.parse(line)
58			select {
59			case p.ch <- ev:
60			default:
61				p.Dropped++
62			}
63		}
64		return len(data), nil
65	}

51	// New creates a Manager. It does not start any processes; call Start.
52	func New(cfg *config.Config, log *slog.Logger) *Manager {
53		m := new(Manager)
54		m.cfg = cfg
55		m.log = log
56		m.procs = make(map[string]*procState)
57		m.eventCh = make(chan monitor.ServerEvent, 256)

71	// Snapshot returns a point-in-time copy of the runtime state of all managed
72	// backends. It acquires read locks and is safe to call concurrently.
73	func (m *Manager) Snapshot() []monitor.BackendStatus {
74		m.mu.RLock()
75		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
76	
77		result := make([]monitor.BackendStatus, 0, len(m.procs))
78		for name, ps := range m.procs {
79			ps.mu.Lock()
80			pid := 0
81			if ps.proc != nil {
82				pid = ps.proc.Pid
83			}
84			status := monitor.BackendStatus{
85				Name:      name,
86				Model:     ps.backend.Model,
87				Port:      ps.port,
88				PID:       pid,
89				Healthy:   ps.healthy,
90				StartedAt: ps.startedAt,
91				Restarts:  ps.restarts,
92			}
93			ps.mu.Unlock()
94			result = append(result, status)

99	// Start launches supervisor goroutines for all managed backends.
100	// It returns immediately; health checks happen asynchronously.
101	func (m *Manager) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
103		m.cancel = cancel
104	
105		for name, b := range m.cfg.Backends {
106			if !b.IsManaged() {
107				continue
108			}
109			ps := new(procState)
110			ps.backend = b
111			ps.swapCh = make(chan swapRequest, 1)
112	
113			m.mu.Lock()
114			m.procs[name] = ps
115			m.mu.Unlock()
116	
117			m.wg.Add(1)
118			go m.supervise(ctx, name)
119		}
120		return nil
121	}

123	// Stop cancels all managed processes and waits for them to exit.
124	func (m *Manager) Stop() error {
125		if m.cancel != nil {
126			m.cancel()
127		}
128		m.wg.Wait()
129		return nil
130	}

132	// Healthy reports whether a backend is ready to serve requests.
133	// For external backends it performs a best-effort GET /health.
134	func (m *Manager) Healthy(name string) bool {
135		m.mu.RLock()
136		ps, ok := m.procs[name]
137		m.mu.RUnlock()
138	
139		if ok {
140			ps.mu.Lock()
141			defer ps.mu.Unlock()
142			return ps.healthy
143		}
144	
145		b, ok := m.cfg.Backends[name]
146		if !ok || !b.IsExternal() {
147			return false
148		}
149	
150		resp, err := http.Get(b.URL + "/health") //nolint:noctx
151		if err != nil {
152			// Best-effort: some external APIs don't implement /health.
153			return true
154		}
155		defer resp.Body.Close()
156		return resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK
157	}

159	// Addr returns the base URL for a backend.
160	// For managed backends it returns "http://localhost:<port>".
161	// For external backends it returns Backend.URL.
162	func (m *Manager) Addr(name string) (string, bool) {
163		m.mu.RLock()
164		ps, ok := m.procs[name]
165		m.mu.RUnlock()
166	
167		if ok {
168			ps.mu.Lock()
169			defer ps.mu.Unlock()
170			if ps.port == 0 {
171				return "", false
172			}
173			return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", ps.port), true
174		}
175	
176		b, ok := m.cfg.Backends[name]
177		if !ok || !b.IsExternal() {
178			return "", false
179		}
180		return b.URL, true
181	}

183	// Swap hot-swaps the model for a managed backend.
184	// It stops the running process, updates the model, starts a new process, and
185	// waits up to 120 seconds for the health check to pass.
186	func (m *Manager) Swap(ctx context.Context, name, model string) error {
187		m.mu.RLock()
188		ps, ok := m.procs[name]
189		m.mu.RUnlock()
190	
191		if !ok {
192			return fmt.Errorf("backend %q is not a managed backend", name)
193		}
194	
195		doneCh := make(chan error, 1)
196		select {
197		case ps.swapCh <- swapRequest{model: model, doneCh: doneCh}:
198		case <-ctx.Done():
199			return ctx.Err()
200		}
201	
202		select {
203		case err := <-doneCh:
204			return err
205		case <-ctx.Done():
206			return ctx.Err()
207		}
208	}

210	// supervise is the per-backend restart loop. It runs until ctx is cancelled
211	// or max retries are exceeded.
212	func (m *Manager) supervise(ctx context.Context, name string) {
213		defer m.wg.Done()
214	
215		m.mu.RLock()
216		ps := m.procs[name]
217		m.mu.RUnlock()
218	
219		defer func() {
220			ps.mu.Lock()
221			ps.healthy = false
222			ps.proc = nil
223			ps.mu.Unlock()
224		}()
225	
226		const (
227			maxRetries  = 5
228			retryWindow = 60 * time.Second
229			backoff     = 2 * time.Second
230		)
231	
232		var (
233			attempts    int
234			windowStart = time.Now()
235			launched    bool // false on the very first launch
236		)
237	
238		for {
239			select {
240			case <-ctx.Done():
241				return
242			default:
243			}
244	
245			// Reset the retry counter when the window has elapsed.
246			if time.Since(windowStart) > retryWindow {
247				attempts = 0
248				windowStart = time.Now()
249			}
250	
251			if attempts >= maxRetries {
252				m.log.Error("max restart retries exceeded, giving up", "backend", name)
253				return
254			}
255	
256			if attempts > 0 {
257				m.log.Info("restarting backend", "backend", name, "attempt", attempts)
258				select {
259				case <-ctx.Done():
260					return
261				case <-time.After(backoff):
262				}
263			}
264	
265			attempts++
266	
267			port, err := freePort()
268			if err != nil {
269				m.log.Error("port allocation failed", "backend", name, "error", err)
270				continue
271			}
272	
273			ps.mu.Lock()
274			ps.port = port
275			ps.healthy = false
276			backend := ps.backend
277			if launched {
278				ps.restarts++
279			}
280			ps.startedAt = time.Now()
281			ps.mu.Unlock()
282			launched = true
283	
284			cmd, err := m.launch(ctx, name, backend, port)
285			if err != nil {
286				m.log.Error("failed to launch llama-server", "backend", name, "error", err)
287				continue
288			}
289	
290			ps.mu.Lock()
291			ps.proc = cmd.Process
292			ps.mu.Unlock()
293	
294			if err := waitHealthy(ctx, port, 120*time.Second); err != nil {
295				m.log.Error("health check failed on start", "backend", name, "error", err)
296				cmd.Process.Kill()
297				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
298				ps.mu.Lock()
299				ps.proc = nil
300				ps.mu.Unlock()
301				continue
302			}
303	
304			ps.mu.Lock()
305			ps.healthy = true
306			ps.mu.Unlock()
307			m.log.Info("backend healthy", "backend", name, "port", port)
308	
309			exitCh := make(chan error, 1)
310			go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
311	
312		monitor:
313			for {
314				select {
315				case <-ctx.Done():
316					// cmd.Cancel sends SIGTERM; cmd.WaitDelay gives 10s then SIGKILL.
317					<-exitCh
318					return
319	
320				case req := <-ps.swapCh:
321					ps.mu.Lock()
322					ps.healthy = false
323					ps.backend.Model = req.model
324					backend = ps.backend
325					ps.mu.Unlock()
326	
327					cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM) //nolint:errcheck
328					select {
329					case <-exitCh:
330					case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
331						cmd.Process.Kill() //nolint:errcheck
332						<-exitCh
333					}
334	
335					ps.mu.Lock()
336					ps.proc = nil
337					ps.mu.Unlock()
338	
339					newPort, portErr := freePort()
340					if portErr != nil {
341						req.doneCh <- portErr
342						break monitor
343					}
344	
345					ps.mu.Lock()
346					ps.port = newPort
347					ps.restarts++
348					ps.startedAt = time.Now()
349					ps.mu.Unlock()
350	
351					newCmd, launchErr := m.launch(ctx, name, backend, newPort)
352					if launchErr != nil {
353						req.doneCh <- launchErr
354						break monitor
355					}
356	
357					ps.mu.Lock()
358					ps.proc = newCmd.Process
359					ps.mu.Unlock()
360	
361					if healthErr := waitHealthy(ctx, newPort, 120*time.Second); healthErr != nil {
362						newCmd.Process.Kill() //nolint:errcheck
363						newCmd.Wait()         //nolint:errcheck
364						ps.mu.Lock()
365						ps.proc = nil
366						ps.mu.Unlock()
367						req.doneCh <- healthErr
368						break monitor
369					}
370	
371					ps.mu.Lock()
372					ps.healthy = true
373					ps.mu.Unlock()
374					m.log.Info("swap complete", "backend", name, "port", newPort, "model", req.model)
375					req.doneCh <- nil
376	
377					cmd = newCmd
378					exitCh = make(chan error, 1)
379					go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
380	
381				case exitErr := <-exitCh:
382					ps.mu.Lock()
383					ps.healthy = false
384					ps.proc = nil
385					ps.mu.Unlock()
386	
387					if ctx.Err() != nil {
388						return
389					}
390	
391					if exitErr != nil {
392						if ee, ok := errors.AsType[*exec.ExitError](exitErr); ok {
393							m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "backend", name, "exit_code", ee.ExitCode())
394						} else {
395							m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "backend", name, "error", exitErr)
396						}
397					}
398					break monitor
399				}
400			}
401			// Fall through to retry.
402		}
403	}

405	// launch starts a llama-server process and wires its stdout/stderr to slog.
406	func (m *Manager) launch(ctx context.Context, name string, b config.Backend, port int) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
407		cmd := m.cmdBuilder(ctx, b, port)
408	
409		cmd.Cancel = func() error {
410			if cmd.Process == nil {
411				return nil
412			}
413			return cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM)
414		}
415		cmd.WaitDelay = 10 * time.Second
416	
417		parser := monitor.NewEventParser(m.log, name, m.eventCh)
418		cmd.Stdout = parser
419		cmd.Stderr = parser
420	
421		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
422			return nil, err
423		}
424		return cmd, nil
425	}
426	
427	// buildArgs constructs the llama-server command-line arguments from a Backend config.
428	func buildArgs(b config.Backend, port int) []string {
429		args := []string{
430			"-hf", b.Model,
431			"--port", strconv.Itoa(port),
432			"--no-webui",
433		}
434		if b.GPULayers > 0 {
435			args = append(args, "-ngl", strconv.Itoa(b.GPULayers))
436		}
437		if b.Context > 0 {
438			args = append(args, "-c", strconv.Itoa(b.Context))
439		}
440		if b.Pooling != "" {
441			args = append(args, "--embedding", "--pooling", b.Pooling)
442		}
443		return append(args, b.Extra...)
444	}
445	
446	// freePort finds a free TCP port by binding to :0 and immediately releasing it.
447	func freePort() (int, error) {
448		l, err := net.Listen("tcp", ":0")
449		if err != nil {
450			return 0, err
451		}
452		port := l.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
453		l.Close()
454		return port, nil
455	}
456	
457	// waitHealthy polls GET /health on the given port every second until it
458	// returns 200 OK, the context is cancelled, or the timeout elapses.
459	func waitHealthy(ctx context.Context, port int, timeout time.Duration) error {
460		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
461		defer cancel()
462	
463		url := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d/health", port)
464		client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
465		ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
466		defer ticker.Stop()
467	
468		for {
469			select {
470			case <-ctx.Done():
471				return ctx.Err()
472			case <-ticker.C:
473				resp, err := client.Get(url) //nolint:noctx
474				if err == nil {
475					resp.Body.Close()
476					if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
477						return nil
478					}
479				}
480			}
481		}
482	}

11	// Compiled regexes for llama-server stderr patterns.
12	// Initialised once at package init — never per-line.
13	var (
14		rePromptEval = regexp.MustCompile(
15			`prompt eval time\s*=\s*([\d.]+)\s*ms\s*/\s*(\d+)\s*tokens\s*\([^,]+,\s*([\d.]+)\s*tokens/s\)`)
16		// reGenEval matches "eval time" lines; checked after rePromptEval so
17		// "prompt eval time" lines are never reached here.
18		reGenEval = regexp.MustCompile(
19			`\beval time\s*=\s*([\d.]+)\s*ms\s*/\s*(\d+)\s*tokens\s*\([^,]+,\s*([\d.]+)\s*tokens/s\)`)
20		reSlotProc  = regexp.MustCompile(`slot\s+(\d+)\s+is\s+processing`)
21		reSlotRel   = regexp.MustCompile(`slot\s+(\d+)\s+released`)
22		reModelLoad = regexp.MustCompile(`llm_load_tensors:\s+offloading\s+(\d+)\s+layers\s+to\s+GPU`)
23		reVRAMAlloc = regexp.MustCompile(`llm_load_tensors:\s+\S+\s+buffer\s+size\s*=\s*([\d.]+)\s*MiB`)
24	)
25	
26	// eventParser implements io.Writer. It buffers bytes, splits on newlines,
27	// writes each complete line to slog.Debug (preserving existing behaviour), and
28	// sends a structured ServerEvent to ch. Sends are non-blocking; if ch is full
29	// the event is dropped and Dropped is incremented.
30	type eventParser struct {
31		log     *slog.Logger
32		name    string
33		ch      chan<- ServerEvent
34		buf     bytes.Buffer
35		Dropped uint64
36	}
37	
38	// NewEventParser returns an eventParser for the named backend.
39	func NewEventParser(log *slog.Logger, name string, ch chan<- ServerEvent) *eventParser {
40		return &eventParser{log: log, name: name, ch: ch}
41	}
42	
43	func (p *eventParser) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
44		p.buf.Write(data)
45		for {
46			b := p.buf.Bytes()
47			idx := bytes.IndexByte(b, '\n')
48			if idx < 0 {
49				break
50			}
51			line := string(b[:idx])
52			p.buf.Next(idx + 1)
53			if len(line) == 0 {
54				continue
55			}
56			p.log.Debug(line, "backend", p.name)
57			ev := p.parse(line)
58			select {
59			case p.ch <- ev:
60			default:
61				p.Dropped++
62			}
63		}
64		return len(data), nil
65	}
66	
67	func (p *eventParser) parse(line string) ServerEvent {
68		ev := ServerEvent{
69			Time:    time.Now(),
70			Backend: p.name,
71			Slot:    -1,
72		}
73	
74		if m := rePromptEval.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
75			ev.Kind = EventPromptEval
76			ev.DurationMs, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(m[1], 64)
77			ev.Tokens, _ = strconv.Atoi(m[2])
78			ev.TokPerSec, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(m[3], 64)
79			return ev
80		}
81	
82		if m := reGenEval.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
83			ev.Kind = EventGenEval
84			ev.DurationMs, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(m[1], 64)
85			ev.Tokens, _ = strconv.Atoi(m[2])
86			ev.TokPerSec, _ = strconv.ParseFloat(m[3], 64)
87			return ev
88		}
89	
90		if m := reSlotProc.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
91			ev.Kind = EventSlotAssign
92			ev.Slot, _ = strconv.Atoi(m[1])
93			return ev
94		}
95	
96		if m := reSlotRel.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
97			ev.Kind = EventSlotRelease
98			ev.Slot, _ = strconv.Atoi(m[1])
99			return ev
100		}
101	
102		if reModelLoad.MatchString(line) {
103			ev.Kind = EventModelLoad
104			ev.Message = line
105			return ev
106		}
107	
108		if reVRAMAlloc.MatchString(line) {
109			ev.Kind = EventVRAMAlloc
110			ev.Message = line
111			return ev
112		}
113	
114		ev.Kind = EventRaw
115		ev.Message = line
116		return ev
117	}
